actionCalls.name: Count_Student_Absences
actionCalls.label: Count Student Absences
actionCalls.description: Counts the student's Absent attendance entries since the window start. Apex action (StudentAbsenceCounter) because Flow cannot use AttendanceEntry in this org; see ADR-012. Bulk-safe: one query per batch of interviews.

assignments.name: Set_Low_Grade
assignments.label: Set Low Grade to True
assignments.description: Flags a below-C grade and records the course.

assignments.name: Set_Grade_Drop
assignments.label: Set Grade Drop to True
assignments.description: Flags a letter-grade drop and records the course.

decisions.name: Is_This_the_Latest_Login
decisions.label: Is This the Latest Login?
decisions.description: Checks whether this course's login is the newest so far.

decisions.name: Is_the_Grade_Below_C
decisions.label: Is the Grade Below C?
decisions.description: Checks the current grade against the low grade threshold.

decisions.name: Did_the_Grade_Drop_a_Letter
decisions.label: Did the Grade Drop a Letter?
decisions.description: Compares the letter band now with two weeks ago.

Flow.description: Nightly first-year risk score (SCA-9) and plain-language reason (SCA-11). Runs nightly at 02:00 org time (Pacific; 05:00 Eastern), once per active Freshman term enrollment. Points (from Risk Score Setting, Default): 2 per Absent class in 14 days (max 6); no classroom login 5-9 days = 3, 10+ = 5; any grade below 70 = 3; any grade down a letter band in two weeks = 2. Writes Risk Score, Risk Reason and Risk Scored At on the student Contact. Absences are counted by the StudentAbsenceCounter Apex action (ADR-012). Update Message v1: first version.

formulas.name: forD_WindowStart
formulas.description: First day of the missed-class window (today minus Missed Class Window Days).

formulas.name: forB_IsLatestLogin
formulas.description: True when this course's last login is the most recent seen so far.

formulas.name: forB_IsBelowC
formulas.description: True when this course's current grade is below the low grade threshold (below C).

formulas.name: forN_CurrentBand
formulas.description: Letter band of the current grade: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0.

formulas.name: forN_PriorBand
formulas.description: Letter band of the grade two weeks ago: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0.

formulas.name: forB_DroppedLetter
formulas.description: True when this course's grade fell at least one letter band in two weeks.

formulas.name: forT_CourseShortName
formulas.description: Course code from the course name (text before ' - '), used in the risk reason.

formulas.name: forT_LowGradeCoursesNext
formulas.description: Low-grade course list with this course added.

formulas.name: forT_DropCoursesNext
formulas.description: Grade-drop course list with this course added.

formulas.name: forN_MissedPoints
formulas.description: Missed-class points: points per absence, capped at the maximum.

formulas.name: forN_DaysSinceLogin
formulas.description: Days since the most recent classroom login across courses; -1 when there is no classroom activity.

formulas.name: forN_LoginPoints
formulas.description: No-login points: long band, short band or none.

formulas.name: forN_LowGradePoints
formulas.description: Points when any current grade is below C.

formulas.name: forN_GradeDropPoints
formulas.description: Points when any grade dropped a letter in two weeks.

formulas.name: forT_ReasonParts
formulas.expression: IF({!forN_MissedPoints} > 0, "; missed " & TEXT({!varN_Absences}) & IF({!varN_Absences} = 1, " class", " classes") & " in the last " & TEXT({!Get_Risk_Score_Setting.Missed_Class_Window_Days__c}) & " days", "") & IF({!forN_LoginPoints} > 0, "; no classroom login in " & TEXT({!forN_DaysSinceLogin}) & " days", "") & IF({!forN_LowGradePoints} > 0, "; grade below C in " & {!varT_LowGradeCourses}, "") & IF({!forN_GradeDropPoints} > 0, "; grade dropped a letter in " & {!varT_DropCourses}, "")

formulas.name: forT_RiskReason
formulas.description: Plain-language risk reason, for example 'Missed 2 classes in the last 14 days; no classroom login in 5 days'. Blank when nothing contributed (SCA-11).

Flow.label: SCH – Score First Year Students

loops.name: Loop_Through_Classroom_Activities
loops.label: Loop Through Classroom Activities
loops.description: Looks at each of the student's courses for the latest login, a below-C grade and a letter drop. No queries or DML inside the loop.

recordLookups.name: Get_Risk_Score_Setting
recordLookups.label: Get Risk Score Setting
recordLookups.description: Reads the Default scoring weights and windows (SCA-10).

recordLookups.name: Get_Classroom_Activities
recordLookups.label: Get Classroom Activities
recordLookups.description: The student's simulated classroom activity, one per course.

recordUpdates.name: Update_Contact
recordUpdates.label: Update Contact
recordUpdates.description: Writes the risk score, the plain-language reason and the scoring time to the student Contact. A failure is left unhandled on purpose so Salesforce reports it (flow error email and the failed interview); handling it here would hide it.

variables.name: varN_Absences
variables.description: Number of Absent attendance entries in the missed-class window (from the Count Student Absences action).

variables.name: varDT_LatestLogin
variables.description: Most recent classroom login across the student's courses.

variables.name: varB_LowGrade
variables.description: True when any current grade is below C.

variables.name: varB_GradeDrop
variables.description: True when any grade dropped a letter in two weeks.

variables.name: varT_LowGradeCourses
variables.description: Courses with a grade below C, comma-separated.

variables.name: varT_DropCourses
variables.description: Courses whose grade dropped a letter, comma-separated.
